canonical_project: Rajasthan State Data Centre estate (RSDC P1/P3/P4 incl. Bhamashah State Data Centre)
owner: Department of Information Technology & Communication, Government of Rajasthan / RISL
notes: Rajasthan investment portal (rising.rajasthan.gov.in) states the state data centre runs 800 racks across Jaipur plus 1 Jodhpur DR site; Sterling & Wilson project page identifies Bhamashah State Data Center, Jaipur as a 600-rack, Tier IV-certified greenfield project completed 2019; APMG ISO/IEC 20000 certification lists RSDC P1, P3 and P4 locations in Jaipur. Government SDC (e-governance), not commercial colocation.
